hook_text: Three days of paddling from Pietermaritzburg to Durban. Which rivers carry them there?
clip_script: Pietermaritzburg, the start of the Dusi Canoe Marathon. Paddlers ride the uMsunduzi into the uMngeni, all the way to the sea at Durban. South Africa's rivers follow a pattern. East of the escarpment: short, steep rivers like the Thukela, racing to the Indian Ocean. West of it: the long Gariep, from Lesotho to the Atlantic, with the Vaal joining on the way. And in the north, the Limpopo, flowing east along our border.
visual_style: Whiteboard canoes racing down a blue river, then a map of South Africa with rivers drawing themselves from source to mouth.
mood: Energetic and splashy, like a canoe race through rapids.
pacing: Fast race start, then steady tracing of each river to its ocean.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and trace the rivers of your province on a map.
